certifiedResults.metadataNotes: Aggregated from the official Maine Secretary of State corrected final President and Vice President workbook. County rows use county total rows, plus the statewide UOCAVA row so the app reconciles to the certified statewide candidate total; municipality rows are counted as local reporting rows for source coverage.

turnout.sourceTitle: Maine 2024 President and Vice President final workbook joined to active registered and enrolled voter file
turnout.sourceAuthority: Maine Department of the Secretary of State
turnout.notes: County turnout joins the official corrected presidential workbook TBC county totals to the official active registered and enrolled voter file as of November 5, 2024. Warning shown because rows are county-level and use active registered voters, not a lower-level final turnout file.

certifiedResults.title: Maine official presidential county results
certifiedResults.detail: Certified county presidential totals are parsed from the Maine Secretary of State final corrected President and Vice President workbook.
certifiedResults.sourceTimestampBasis: Maine SOS source filename identifies the workbook as FINAL-Corrected 20241205.

wardDetail.title: Maine municipality-level presidential rows
wardDetail.detail: The same official workbook includes municipality rows that reconcile to county total rows, plus a statewide UOCAVA row that is not county-assigned. The app retains these source rows in pipeline metadata.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: Maine SOS workbook rows include municipality totals and county subtotal rows.

turnout.title: Maine county turnout from official presidential TBC totals and active voter registration
turnout.detail: County turnout rows join the official corrected President and Vice President workbook's TBC county totals to the official Statewide Registered and Enrolled Data File for active voters as of November 5, 2024. Rows are county-level and warning-required because the denominator is an active registered-voter file rather than a precinct-level turnout file.
turnout.sourceTimestampBasis: Maine SOS enrolled-data layout page states the active voter file is as of 05-Nov-2024 and page content is dated 12/27/2024.
